branch_5_name.description: Branch 5 | Unique branch name (portable identifier); also names its registered model

branch_5_task.description: Branch 5 | What will the model predict? regression = a number; classification = a category

branch_5_sample_weight_enabled.description: Use sample weights? false = No (default); true = Yes.

branch_5_weight_column.description: Training-only sample-weight column (excluded from model features).

branch_5_target_column.description: Branch 5 | Column containing the known answer during training, e.g. churn or claim_amount

branch_5_input_columns.description: Branch 5 | Columns the model learns from, e.g. income, age, balance. Separate names with commas; exclude record keys and the answer column

branch_5_preprocessing_recipe.description: Branch 5 | Named recipe from config/preprocessing.yml: default, none, example_imputer, example_frequency, example_imputer_frequency or example_all; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_5_pre_split_recipe.description: Branch 5 | Named recipe from config/pre_split.yml: default, none, example_complete_inputs or example_all; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_5_cv_enabled.description: Branch 5 | Use several training-only folds to score search candidates? No duplicate post-search CV report. With CV off, search uses a training-only validation split. Final test rows stay separate. Defaults: 5-fold K-fold, shuffle enabled, seed 42; the following questions select the fold policy before the data window. Model competition always enables the shared CV policy.

branch_5_cv_folds.description: Branch 5 | How many CV splits? 5 means five evaluations; more splits take longer (2-20)

branch_5_cv_type.description: Branch 5 | Fold method: k_fold, stratified_k_fold, time_series_split, shuffle_split, group_k_fold, stratified_group_k_fold, or nested_cv. Nested CV repeats an independent inner search in every outer training fold, then runs a separate final search Temporal CV automatically selects a chronological final holdout; its clock/window questions follow.

branch_5_cv_inner_folds.description: Branch 5 | Inner search folds for nested CV (2-20). Leave blank for the Core default. The strategy budget applies to every outer-fold search and the final search.

branch_5_cv_nested_type.description: Branch 5 | Policy at both nested levels; auto selects stratified classification or regression K-fold. Temporal requires a temporal final holdout and event_column.

branch_5_cv_group_column.description: Branch 5 | Group identity column, excluded from features. Final holdout isolates whole groups; disable holdout stratify.

branch_5_cv_gap.description: Branch 5 | Rows excluded before each temporal validation window at both nested levels.

branch_5_cv_test_size.description: Branch 5 | Temporal validation rows per fold; null uses the Core default.

branch_5_cv_max_train_size.description: Branch 5 | Temporal training rows; null expands, an integer creates a rolling window.

branch_5_cv_shuffle.description: Branch 5 | Shuffle rows for CV? Use false for time_series_split, true for shuffle_split

branch_5_cv_random_state.description: Branch 5 | Seed for repeatable CV splits. Keep 42 unless you want different splits

branch_5_split_strategy.description: Branch 5 | How to reserve test rows? random = random rows; temporal = newer rows for testing and older rows for training. Default source: full snapshot for random, rolling calendar for temporal. Override training_window_mode in an init file.

branch_5_test_size.description: Branch 5 | Share of rows reserved for final testing: 0.2 means 20% test and 80% training

branch_5_random_state.description: Branch 5 | Seed for repeatable random splitting. Keep 42 unless you want a different split

branch_5_stratify.description: Branch 5 | Keep similar proportions of each target class in training and test rows?

branch_5_training_window_mode.description: Branch 5 | Which source rows to use? full_snapshot = all; fixed_window = dates you enter; rolling_calendar = recent complete months; rolling_days = last N elapsed UTC days; auto = all for random, recent months for temporal

branch_5_lookback_days.description: Branch 5 | Total elapsed 24-hour days before each run to read, including holdout; enter 1 to 36500

branch_5_holdout_days.description: Branch 5 | Final elapsed days reserved for temporal testing; enter 1 to lookback_days minus 1

branch_5_window_timezone.description: Branch 5 | Timezone defining calendar month boundaries, e.g. Europe/Copenhagen. This controls selected data, not when the job runs

branch_5_monthly_lookback_months.description: Branch 5 | Total complete past months to read, including the final holdout. Example: 4 months with a 2-month holdout leaves 2 months for training

branch_5_holdout_months.description: Branch 5 | How many final complete months to hold out for testing? Enter 1 to total lookback minus 1; example: 2

branch_5_event_column.description: Branch 5 | Column containing when each record was observed, e.g. observation_date; used to select older/newer data

branch_5_event_time_kind.description: Branch 5 | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_5_event_text_kind.description: Branch 5 | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_5_event_time_format.description: Branch 5 | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_5_event_time_timezone.description: Branch 5 | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_5_event_date_only.description: Branch 5 | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_5_start.description: Branch 5 | Earliest observation to include, e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00+02:00. Required for fixed_window; rolling_calendar calculates it for every run

branch_5_holdout_start.description: Branch 5 | Observations from this time onward are test rows, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00+02:00. Older selected rows train the model; rolling runs calculate it

branch_5_cutoff.description: Branch 5 | Stop before this observation time, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00+02:00. This is a data boundary, not the job date; rolling runs calculate it

branch_5_filter_unavailable_results.description: Branch 5 | Do answers become known later? true = exclude rows whose answer was not yet available at the chosen time; false = use supplied answers

branch_5_result_availability_lag_hours.description: Branch 5 | When result_cutoff is blank, subtract this many hours from run start. Enter 0 to 87600; example: 48 excludes results available in the last two days. An explicit result_cutoff overrides this lag for every run

branch_5_result_available_at_column.description: Branch 5 | Column recording when each answer became known, e.g. claim_confirmed_at. This is a column name, not a date you enter

branch_5_result_time_kind.description: Branch 5 | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_5_result_text_kind.description: Branch 5 | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_5_result_time_format.description: Branch 5 | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_5_result_time_timezone.description: Branch 5 | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_5_result_date_only.description: Branch 5 | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_5_result_cutoff.description: Branch 5 | Use answers known by this time, INCLUDING this instant, e.g. 2026-09-15T00:00:00+02:00. An explicit cutoff applies to every run; blank derives run start minus result_availability_lag_hours

branch_5_max_rows.description: Branch 5 | Maximum rows transferred into Python memory per read; exceeding this stops the run. This does not randomly sample rows

branch_5_max_input_mb.description: Branch 5 | Maximum input data size transferred into Python memory, in MiB (64 = 64 MiB). Model training can use more RAM

branch_5_training_sample_rows.description: Branch 5 | Optional sample: enter 10000 to select up to 10000 eligible rows BEFORE train/test splitting. null = no sampling. Prediction rows are never sampled

branch_5_training_sample_seed.description: Branch 5 | Seed for choosing the same sample from the same table snapshot. Keep 42 unless you want another sample

branch_5_regression_model.description: Branch 5 | Choose a regression model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_5_regression_model_weighted.description: Branch 5 | Choose a regression model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_5_classification_model.description: Branch 5 | Choose a classification model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_5_classification_model_weighted.description: Branch 5 | Choose a classification model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_5_model_params.description: Branch 5 | Optional JSON object of fixed model parameters. For voting/stacking, include base_estimators and any base_estimator_params or final_estimator to define the ensemble. Other models can set this in an init file or generated config

branch_5_search_strategy.description: Branch 5 | Choose grid, random, halving_grid, halving_random, or optional Optuna. Core supplies a model-appropriate default search space; grid strategies evaluate its full Cartesian product

branch_5_search_settings.description: Branch 5 | Use Core defaults for this strategy, or customize its controls below

branch_5_search_max_candidates.description: Branch 5 | Maximum full-grid combinations to admit (1-10000). Grid and halving_grid run every combination, so preflight rejects a larger space

branch_5_search_space.description: Optional init-file search override; otherwise Bundle writes Core-derived editable lists into this branch. Edit its generated search_space or clear it to {} for automatic resolution.

branch_5_regression_search_metric.description: Branch 5 | Objective for choosing regression parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_5_classification_search_metric.description: Branch 5 | Objective for choosing classification parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_5_search_n_trials.description: Branch 5 | Trials or initial sampled candidates for random, halving_random and Optuna (1-1000)

branch_5_search_timeout.description: Branch 5 | Optional Optuna soft stop in positive seconds; null disables it. A running estimator fit is not interrupted

branch_5_search_random_state.description: Branch 5 | Seed for sampled parameter choices, separate from the heldout split seed and CV fold seed

branch_5_search_factor.description: Branch 5 | Successive halving keeps roughly one in this many candidates per round (integer 2 or more)

branch_5_search_resource.description: Branch 5 | Halving budget resource: training rows or estimator n_estimators. n_estimators requires explicit max_resources and a compatible model

branch_5_search_min_resources.description: Branch 5 | Halving starting budget: exhaust, smallest, or a positive integer

branch_5_search_estimator_min_resources.description: Branch 5 | Starting estimator budget for n_estimators halving (integer 2 or more; must not exceed max_resources)

branch_5_search_max_resources.description: Branch 5 | Maximum estimator resource count for n_estimators halving; enter a positive integer compatible with the selected model

branch_5_search_sampler.description: Branch 5 | Optuna sampler: TPE, random or CMA-ES; CMA-ES samples categorical axes randomly

branch_5_search_pruner.description: Branch 5 | Optuna trial pruner; Core checks whether the selected model and validation method support early stopping. none disables pruning

branch_5_search_pruning.description: Branch 5 | Allow Optuna pruning when model and validation settings support it

branch_5_search_tune_threshold.description: Branch 5 | Select a binary decision threshold from inner out-of-fold predictions. Requires probability output; final holdout stays untouched.

branch_5_regression_metric.description: Branch 5 | Metric for comparing regression models on separate test data (heldout). Lower error is better; higher R2 or explained variance is better

branch_5_classification_metric.description: Branch 5 | Metric for comparing classification models on separate test data (heldout). Some metrics need probabilities or specific class counts

branch_5_min_improvement.description: Branch 5 | Minimum metric improvement required for manual or automatic promotion; ties never pass

branch_5_quality_threshold.description: Branch 5 | Absolute quality gate; numeric required for automatic promotion or manual first-champion approval. Choose for your metric and task.

branch_5_quality_gates.description: Branch 5 | Optional init-file JSON object of additional heldout metric thresholds, or null

branch_6_name.description: Branch 6 | Unique branch name (portable identifier); also names its registered model

branch_6_task.description: Branch 6 | What will the model predict? regression = a number; classification = a category

branch_6_sample_weight_enabled.description: Use sample weights? false = No (default); true = Yes.

branch_6_weight_column.description: Training-only sample-weight column (excluded from model features).

branch_6_target_column.description: Branch 6 | Column containing the known answer during training, e.g. churn or claim_amount

branch_6_input_columns.description: Branch 6 | Columns the model learns from, e.g. income, age, balance. Separate names with commas; exclude record keys and the answer column

branch_6_preprocessing_recipe.description: Branch 6 | Named recipe from config/preprocessing.yml: default, none, example_imputer, example_frequency, example_imputer_frequency or example_all; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_6_pre_split_recipe.description: Branch 6 | Named recipe from config/pre_split.yml: default, none, example_complete_inputs or example_all; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_6_cv_enabled.description: Branch 6 | Use several training-only folds to score search candidates? No duplicate post-search CV report. With CV off, search uses a training-only validation split. Final test rows stay separate. Defaults: 5-fold K-fold, shuffle enabled, seed 42; the following questions select the fold policy before the data window. Model competition always enables the shared CV policy.

branch_6_cv_folds.description: Branch 6 | How many CV splits? 5 means five evaluations; more splits take longer (2-20)

branch_6_cv_type.description: Branch 6 | Fold method: k_fold, stratified_k_fold, time_series_split, shuffle_split, group_k_fold, stratified_group_k_fold, or nested_cv. Nested CV repeats an independent inner search in every outer training fold, then runs a separate final search Temporal CV automatically selects a chronological final holdout; its clock/window questions follow.

branch_6_cv_inner_folds.description: Branch 6 | Inner search folds for nested CV (2-20). Leave blank for the Core default. The strategy budget applies to every outer-fold search and the final search.

branch_6_cv_nested_type.description: Branch 6 | Policy at both nested levels; auto selects stratified classification or regression K-fold. Temporal requires a temporal final holdout and event_column.

branch_6_cv_group_column.description: Branch 6 | Group identity column, excluded from features. Final holdout isolates whole groups; disable holdout stratify.

branch_6_cv_gap.description: Branch 6 | Rows excluded before each temporal validation window at both nested levels.

branch_6_cv_test_size.description: Branch 6 | Temporal validation rows per fold; null uses the Core default.

branch_6_cv_max_train_size.description: Branch 6 | Temporal training rows; null expands, an integer creates a rolling window.

branch_6_cv_shuffle.description: Branch 6 | Shuffle rows for CV? Use false for time_series_split, true for shuffle_split

branch_6_cv_random_state.description: Branch 6 | Seed for repeatable CV splits. Keep 42 unless you want different splits

branch_6_split_strategy.description: Branch 6 | How to reserve test rows? random = random rows; temporal = newer rows for testing and older rows for training. Default source: full snapshot for random, rolling calendar for temporal. Override training_window_mode in an init file.

branch_6_test_size.description: Branch 6 | Share of rows reserved for final testing: 0.2 means 20% test and 80% training

branch_6_random_state.description: Branch 6 | Seed for repeatable random splitting. Keep 42 unless you want a different split

branch_6_stratify.description: Branch 6 | Keep similar proportions of each target class in training and test rows?

branch_6_training_window_mode.description: Branch 6 | Which source rows to use? full_snapshot = all; fixed_window = dates you enter; rolling_calendar = recent complete months; rolling_days = last N elapsed UTC days; auto = all for random, recent months for temporal

branch_6_lookback_days.description: Branch 6 | Total elapsed 24-hour days before each run to read, including holdout; enter 1 to 36500

branch_6_holdout_days.description: Branch 6 | Final elapsed days reserved for temporal testing; enter 1 to lookback_days minus 1

branch_6_window_timezone.description: Branch 6 | Timezone defining calendar month boundaries, e.g. Europe/Copenhagen. This controls selected data, not when the job runs

branch_6_monthly_lookback_months.description: Branch 6 | Total complete past months to read, including the final holdout. Example: 4 months with a 2-month holdout leaves 2 months for training

branch_6_holdout_months.description: Branch 6 | How many final complete months to hold out for testing? Enter 1 to total lookback minus 1; example: 2

branch_6_event_column.description: Branch 6 | Column containing when each record was observed, e.g. observation_date; used to select older/newer data

branch_6_event_time_kind.description: Branch 6 | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_6_event_text_kind.description: Branch 6 | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_6_event_time_format.description: Branch 6 | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_6_event_time_timezone.description: Branch 6 | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_6_event_date_only.description: Branch 6 | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_6_start.description: Branch 6 | Earliest observation to include, e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00+02:00. Required for fixed_window; rolling_calendar calculates it for every run

branch_6_holdout_start.description: Branch 6 | Observations from this time onward are test rows, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00+02:00. Older selected rows train the model; rolling runs calculate it

branch_6_cutoff.description: Branch 6 | Stop before this observation time, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00+02:00. This is a data boundary, not the job date; rolling runs calculate it

branch_6_filter_unavailable_results.description: Branch 6 | Do answers become known later? true = exclude rows whose answer was not yet available at the chosen time; false = use supplied answers

branch_6_result_availability_lag_hours.description: Branch 6 | When result_cutoff is blank, subtract this many hours from run start. Enter 0 to 87600; example: 48 excludes results available in the last two days. An explicit result_cutoff overrides this lag for every run

branch_6_result_available_at_column.description: Branch 6 | Column recording when each answer became known, e.g. claim_confirmed_at. This is a column name, not a date you enter

branch_6_result_time_kind.description: Branch 6 | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_6_result_text_kind.description: Branch 6 | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_6_result_time_format.description: Branch 6 | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_6_result_time_timezone.description: Branch 6 | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_6_result_date_only.description: Branch 6 | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_6_result_cutoff.description: Branch 6 | Use answers known by this time, INCLUDING this instant, e.g. 2026-09-15T00:00:00+02:00. An explicit cutoff applies to every run; blank derives run start minus result_availability_lag_hours

branch_6_max_rows.description: Branch 6 | Maximum rows transferred into Python memory per read; exceeding this stops the run. This does not randomly sample rows

branch_6_max_input_mb.description: Branch 6 | Maximum input data size transferred into Python memory, in MiB (64 = 64 MiB). Model training can use more RAM

branch_6_training_sample_rows.description: Branch 6 | Optional sample: enter 10000 to select up to 10000 eligible rows BEFORE train/test splitting. null = no sampling. Prediction rows are never sampled

branch_6_training_sample_seed.description: Branch 6 | Seed for choosing the same sample from the same table snapshot. Keep 42 unless you want another sample

branch_6_regression_model.description: Branch 6 | Choose a regression model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_6_regression_model_weighted.description: Branch 6 | Choose a regression model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_6_classification_model.description: Branch 6 | Choose a classification model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_6_classification_model_weighted.description: Branch 6 | Choose a classification model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_6_model_params.description: Branch 6 | Optional JSON object of fixed model parameters. For voting/stacking, include base_estimators and any base_estimator_params or final_estimator to define the ensemble. Other models can set this in an init file or generated config

branch_6_search_strategy.description: Branch 6 | Choose grid, random, halving_grid, halving_random, or optional Optuna. Core supplies a model-appropriate default search space; grid strategies evaluate its full Cartesian product

branch_6_search_settings.description: Branch 6 | Use Core defaults for this strategy, or customize its controls below

branch_6_search_max_candidates.description: Branch 6 | Maximum full-grid combinations to admit (1-10000). Grid and halving_grid run every combination, so preflight rejects a larger space

branch_6_search_space.description: Optional init-file search override; otherwise Bundle writes Core-derived editable lists into this branch. Edit its generated search_space or clear it to {} for automatic resolution.

branch_6_regression_search_metric.description: Branch 6 | Objective for choosing regression parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_6_classification_search_metric.description: Branch 6 | Objective for choosing classification parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_6_search_n_trials.description: Branch 6 | Trials or initial sampled candidates for random, halving_random and Optuna (1-1000)

branch_6_search_timeout.description: Branch 6 | Optional Optuna soft stop in positive seconds; null disables it. A running estimator fit is not interrupted

branch_6_search_random_state.description: Branch 6 | Seed for sampled parameter choices, separate from the heldout split seed and CV fold seed

branch_6_search_factor.description: Branch 6 | Successive halving keeps roughly one in this many candidates per round (integer 2 or more)

branch_6_search_resource.description: Branch 6 | Halving budget resource: training rows or estimator n_estimators. n_estimators requires explicit max_resources and a compatible model

branch_6_search_min_resources.description: Branch 6 | Halving starting budget: exhaust, smallest, or a positive integer

branch_6_search_estimator_min_resources.description: Branch 6 | Starting estimator budget for n_estimators halving (integer 2 or more; must not exceed max_resources)

branch_6_search_max_resources.description: Branch 6 | Maximum estimator resource count for n_estimators halving; enter a positive integer compatible with the selected model

branch_6_search_sampler.description: Branch 6 | Optuna sampler: TPE, random or CMA-ES; CMA-ES samples categorical axes randomly

branch_6_search_pruner.description: Branch 6 | Optuna trial pruner; Core checks whether the selected model and validation method support early stopping. none disables pruning

branch_6_search_pruning.description: Branch 6 | Allow Optuna pruning when model and validation settings support it

branch_6_search_tune_threshold.description: Branch 6 | Select a binary decision threshold from inner out-of-fold predictions. Requires probability output; final holdout stays untouched.

branch_6_regression_metric.description: Branch 6 | Metric for comparing regression models on separate test data (heldout). Lower error is better; higher R2 or explained variance is better

branch_6_classification_metric.description: Branch 6 | Metric for comparing classification models on separate test data (heldout). Some metrics need probabilities or specific class counts

branch_6_min_improvement.description: Branch 6 | Minimum metric improvement required for manual or automatic promotion; ties never pass

branch_6_quality_threshold.description: Branch 6 | Absolute quality gate; numeric required for automatic promotion or manual first-champion approval. Choose for your metric and task.

branch_6_quality_gates.description: Branch 6 | Optional init-file JSON object of additional heldout metric thresholds, or null

branch_7_name.description: Branch 7 | Unique branch name (portable identifier); also names its registered model

branch_7_task.description: Branch 7 | What will the model predict? regression = a number; classification = a category

branch_7_sample_weight_enabled.description: Use sample weights? false = No (default); true = Yes.

branch_7_weight_column.description: Training-only sample-weight column (excluded from model features).

branch_7_target_column.description: Branch 7 | Column containing the known answer during training, e.g. churn or claim_amount

branch_7_input_columns.description: Branch 7 | Columns the model learns from, e.g. income, age, balance. Separate names with commas; exclude record keys and the answer column

branch_7_preprocessing_recipe.description: Branch 7 | Named recipe from config/preprocessing.yml: default, none, example_imputer, example_frequency, example_imputer_frequency or example_all; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_7_pre_split_recipe.description: Branch 7 | Named recipe from config/pre_split.yml: default, none, example_complete_inputs or example_all; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_7_cv_enabled.description: Branch 7 | Use several training-only folds to score search candidates? No duplicate post-search CV report. With CV off, search uses a training-only validation split. Final test rows stay separate. Defaults: 5-fold K-fold, shuffle enabled, seed 42; the following questions select the fold policy before the data window. Model competition always enables the shared CV policy.

branch_7_cv_folds.description: Branch 7 | How many CV splits? 5 means five evaluations; more splits take longer (2-20)

branch_7_cv_type.description: Branch 7 | Fold method: k_fold, stratified_k_fold, time_series_split, shuffle_split, group_k_fold, stratified_group_k_fold, or nested_cv. Nested CV repeats an independent inner search in every outer training fold, then runs a separate final search Temporal CV automatically selects a chronological final holdout; its clock/window questions follow.

branch_7_cv_inner_folds.description: Branch 7 | Inner search folds for nested CV (2-20). Leave blank for the Core default. The strategy budget applies to every outer-fold search and the final search.

branch_7_cv_nested_type.description: Branch 7 | Policy at both nested levels; auto selects stratified classification or regression K-fold. Temporal requires a temporal final holdout and event_column.

branch_7_cv_group_column.description: Branch 7 | Group identity column, excluded from features. Final holdout isolates whole groups; disable holdout stratify.

branch_7_cv_gap.description: Branch 7 | Rows excluded before each temporal validation window at both nested levels.

branch_7_cv_test_size.description: Branch 7 | Temporal validation rows per fold; null uses the Core default.

branch_7_cv_max_train_size.description: Branch 7 | Temporal training rows; null expands, an integer creates a rolling window.

branch_7_cv_shuffle.description: Branch 7 | Shuffle rows for CV? Use false for time_series_split, true for shuffle_split

branch_7_cv_random_state.description: Branch 7 | Seed for repeatable CV splits. Keep 42 unless you want different splits

branch_7_split_strategy.description: Branch 7 | How to reserve test rows? random = random rows; temporal = newer rows for testing and older rows for training. Default source: full snapshot for random, rolling calendar for temporal. Override training_window_mode in an init file.

branch_7_test_size.description: Branch 7 | Share of rows reserved for final testing: 0.2 means 20% test and 80% training

branch_7_random_state.description: Branch 7 | Seed for repeatable random splitting. Keep 42 unless you want a different split

branch_7_stratify.description: Branch 7 | Keep similar proportions of each target class in training and test rows?

branch_7_training_window_mode.description: Branch 7 | Which source rows to use? full_snapshot = all; fixed_window = dates you enter; rolling_calendar = recent complete months; rolling_days = last N elapsed UTC days; auto = all for random, recent months for temporal

branch_7_lookback_days.description: Branch 7 | Total elapsed 24-hour days before each run to read, including holdout; enter 1 to 36500

branch_7_holdout_days.description: Branch 7 | Final elapsed days reserved for temporal testing; enter 1 to lookback_days minus 1

branch_7_window_timezone.description: Branch 7 | Timezone defining calendar month boundaries, e.g. Europe/Copenhagen. This controls selected data, not when the job runs

branch_7_monthly_lookback_months.description: Branch 7 | Total complete past months to read, including the final holdout. Example: 4 months with a 2-month holdout leaves 2 months for training

branch_7_holdout_months.description: Branch 7 | How many final complete months to hold out for testing? Enter 1 to total lookback minus 1; example: 2

branch_7_event_column.description: Branch 7 | Column containing when each record was observed, e.g. observation_date; used to select older/newer data

branch_7_event_time_kind.description: Branch 7 | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_7_event_text_kind.description: Branch 7 | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_7_event_time_format.description: Branch 7 | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_7_event_time_timezone.description: Branch 7 | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_7_event_date_only.description: Branch 7 | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_7_start.description: Branch 7 | Earliest observation to include, e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00+02:00. Required for fixed_window; rolling_calendar calculates it for every run

branch_7_holdout_start.description: Branch 7 | Observations from this time onward are test rows, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00+02:00. Older selected rows train the model; rolling runs calculate it

branch_7_cutoff.description: Branch 7 | Stop before this observation time, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00+02:00. This is a data boundary, not the job date; rolling runs calculate it

branch_7_filter_unavailable_results.description: Branch 7 | Do answers become known later? true = exclude rows whose answer was not yet available at the chosen time; false = use supplied answers

branch_7_result_availability_lag_hours.description: Branch 7 | When result_cutoff is blank, subtract this many hours from run start. Enter 0 to 87600; example: 48 excludes results available in the last two days. An explicit result_cutoff overrides this lag for every run

branch_7_result_available_at_column.description: Branch 7 | Column recording when each answer became known, e.g. claim_confirmed_at. This is a column name, not a date you enter

branch_7_result_time_kind.description: Branch 7 | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_7_result_text_kind.description: Branch 7 | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_7_result_time_format.description: Branch 7 | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_7_result_time_timezone.description: Branch 7 | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_7_result_date_only.description: Branch 7 | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_7_result_cutoff.description: Branch 7 | Use answers known by this time, INCLUDING this instant, e.g. 2026-09-15T00:00:00+02:00. An explicit cutoff applies to every run; blank derives run start minus result_availability_lag_hours

branch_7_max_rows.description: Branch 7 | Maximum rows transferred into Python memory per read; exceeding this stops the run. This does not randomly sample rows

branch_7_max_input_mb.description: Branch 7 | Maximum input data size transferred into Python memory, in MiB (64 = 64 MiB). Model training can use more RAM

branch_7_training_sample_rows.description: Branch 7 | Optional sample: enter 10000 to select up to 10000 eligible rows BEFORE train/test splitting. null = no sampling. Prediction rows are never sampled

branch_7_training_sample_seed.description: Branch 7 | Seed for choosing the same sample from the same table snapshot. Keep 42 unless you want another sample

branch_7_regression_model.description: Branch 7 | Choose a regression model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_7_regression_model_weighted.description: Branch 7 | Choose a regression model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_7_classification_model.description: Branch 7 | Choose a classification model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_7_classification_model_weighted.description: Branch 7 | Choose a classification model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_7_model_params.description: Branch 7 | Optional JSON object of fixed model parameters. For voting/stacking, include base_estimators and any base_estimator_params or final_estimator to define the ensemble. Other models can set this in an init file or generated config

branch_7_search_strategy.description: Branch 7 | Choose grid, random, halving_grid, halving_random, or optional Optuna. Core supplies a model-appropriate default search space; grid strategies evaluate its full Cartesian product

branch_7_search_settings.description: Branch 7 | Use Core defaults for this strategy, or customize its controls below

branch_7_search_max_candidates.description: Branch 7 | Maximum full-grid combinations to admit (1-10000). Grid and halving_grid run every combination, so preflight rejects a larger space

branch_7_search_space.description: Optional init-file search override; otherwise Bundle writes Core-derived editable lists into this branch. Edit its generated search_space or clear it to {} for automatic resolution.

branch_7_regression_search_metric.description: Branch 7 | Objective for choosing regression parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_7_classification_search_metric.description: Branch 7 | Objective for choosing classification parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_7_search_n_trials.description: Branch 7 | Trials or initial sampled candidates for random, halving_random and Optuna (1-1000)

branch_7_search_timeout.description: Branch 7 | Optional Optuna soft stop in positive seconds; null disables it. A running estimator fit is not interrupted

branch_7_search_random_state.description: Branch 7 | Seed for sampled parameter choices, separate from the heldout split seed and CV fold seed

branch_7_search_factor.description: Branch 7 | Successive halving keeps roughly one in this many candidates per round (integer 2 or more)

branch_7_search_resource.description: Branch 7 | Halving budget resource: training rows or estimator n_estimators. n_estimators requires explicit max_resources and a compatible model

branch_7_search_min_resources.description: Branch 7 | Halving starting budget: exhaust, smallest, or a positive integer

branch_7_search_estimator_min_resources.description: Branch 7 | Starting estimator budget for n_estimators halving (integer 2 or more; must not exceed max_resources)

branch_7_search_max_resources.description: Branch 7 | Maximum estimator resource count for n_estimators halving; enter a positive integer compatible with the selected model

branch_7_search_sampler.description: Branch 7 | Optuna sampler: TPE, random or CMA-ES; CMA-ES samples categorical axes randomly

branch_7_search_pruner.description: Branch 7 | Optuna trial pruner; Core checks whether the selected model and validation method support early stopping. none disables pruning

branch_7_search_pruning.description: Branch 7 | Allow Optuna pruning when model and validation settings support it

branch_7_search_tune_threshold.description: Branch 7 | Select a binary decision threshold from inner out-of-fold predictions. Requires probability output; final holdout stays untouched.

branch_7_regression_metric.description: Branch 7 | Metric for comparing regression models on separate test data (heldout). Lower error is better; higher R2 or explained variance is better

branch_7_classification_metric.description: Branch 7 | Metric for comparing classification models on separate test data (heldout). Some metrics need probabilities or specific class counts

branch_7_min_improvement.description: Branch 7 | Minimum metric improvement required for manual or automatic promotion; ties never pass

branch_7_quality_threshold.description: Branch 7 | Absolute quality gate; numeric required for automatic promotion or manual first-champion approval. Choose for your metric and task.

branch_7_quality_gates.description: Branch 7 | Optional init-file JSON object of additional heldout metric thresholds, or null

branch_8_name.description: Branch 8 | Unique branch name (portable identifier); also names its registered model

branch_8_task.description: Branch 8 | What will the model predict? regression = a number; classification = a category

branch_8_sample_weight_enabled.description: Use sample weights? false = No (default); true = Yes.

branch_8_weight_column.description: Training-only sample-weight column (excluded from model features).

branch_8_target_column.description: Branch 8 | Column containing the known answer during training, e.g. churn or claim_amount

branch_8_input_columns.description: Branch 8 | Columns the model learns from, e.g. income, age, balance. Separate names with commas; exclude record keys and the answer column

branch_8_preprocessing_recipe.description: Branch 8 | Named recipe from config/preprocessing.yml: default, none, example_imputer, example_frequency, example_imputer_frequency or example_all; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_8_pre_split_recipe.description: Branch 8 | Named recipe from config/pre_split.yml: default, none, example_complete_inputs or example_all; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_8_cv_enabled.description: Branch 8 | Use several training-only folds to score search candidates? No duplicate post-search CV report. With CV off, search uses a training-only validation split. Final test rows stay separate. Defaults: 5-fold K-fold, shuffle enabled, seed 42; the following questions select the fold policy before the data window. Model competition always enables the shared CV policy.

branch_8_cv_folds.description: Branch 8 | How many CV splits? 5 means five evaluations; more splits take longer (2-20)

branch_8_cv_type.description: Branch 8 | Fold method: k_fold, stratified_k_fold, time_series_split, shuffle_split, group_k_fold, stratified_group_k_fold, or nested_cv. Nested CV repeats an independent inner search in every outer training fold, then runs a separate final search Temporal CV automatically selects a chronological final holdout; its clock/window questions follow.

branch_8_cv_inner_folds.description: Branch 8 | Inner search folds for nested CV (2-20). Leave blank for the Core default. The strategy budget applies to every outer-fold search and the final search.

branch_8_cv_nested_type.description: Branch 8 | Policy at both nested levels; auto selects stratified classification or regression K-fold. Temporal requires a temporal final holdout and event_column.

branch_8_cv_group_column.description: Branch 8 | Group identity column, excluded from features. Final holdout isolates whole groups; disable holdout stratify.

branch_8_cv_gap.description: Branch 8 | Rows excluded before each temporal validation window at both nested levels.

branch_8_cv_test_size.description: Branch 8 | Temporal validation rows per fold; null uses the Core default.

branch_8_cv_max_train_size.description: Branch 8 | Temporal training rows; null expands, an integer creates a rolling window.

branch_8_cv_shuffle.description: Branch 8 | Shuffle rows for CV? Use false for time_series_split, true for shuffle_split

branch_8_cv_random_state.description: Branch 8 | Seed for repeatable CV splits. Keep 42 unless you want different splits

branch_8_split_strategy.description: Branch 8 | How to reserve test rows? random = random rows; temporal = newer rows for testing and older rows for training. Default source: full snapshot for random, rolling calendar for temporal. Override training_window_mode in an init file.

branch_8_test_size.description: Branch 8 | Share of rows reserved for final testing: 0.2 means 20% test and 80% training

branch_8_random_state.description: Branch 8 | Seed for repeatable random splitting. Keep 42 unless you want a different split

branch_8_stratify.description: Branch 8 | Keep similar proportions of each target class in training and test rows?

branch_8_training_window_mode.description: Branch 8 | Which source rows to use? full_snapshot = all; fixed_window = dates you enter; rolling_calendar = recent complete months; rolling_days = last N elapsed UTC days; auto = all for random, recent months for temporal

branch_8_lookback_days.description: Branch 8 | Total elapsed 24-hour days before each run to read, including holdout; enter 1 to 36500

branch_8_holdout_days.description: Branch 8 | Final elapsed days reserved for temporal testing; enter 1 to lookback_days minus 1

branch_8_window_timezone.description: Branch 8 | Timezone defining calendar month boundaries, e.g. Europe/Copenhagen. This controls selected data, not when the job runs

branch_8_monthly_lookback_months.description: Branch 8 | Total complete past months to read, including the final holdout. Example: 4 months with a 2-month holdout leaves 2 months for training

branch_8_holdout_months.description: Branch 8 | How many final complete months to hold out for testing? Enter 1 to total lookback minus 1; example: 2

branch_8_event_column.description: Branch 8 | Column containing when each record was observed, e.g. observation_date; used to select older/newer data

branch_8_event_time_kind.description: Branch 8 | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_8_event_text_kind.description: Branch 8 | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_8_event_time_format.description: Branch 8 | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_8_event_time_timezone.description: Branch 8 | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_8_event_date_only.description: Branch 8 | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_8_start.description: Branch 8 | Earliest observation to include, e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00+02:00. Required for fixed_window; rolling_calendar calculates it for every run

branch_8_holdout_start.description: Branch 8 | Observations from this time onward are test rows, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00+02:00. Older selected rows train the model; rolling runs calculate it

branch_8_cutoff.description: Branch 8 | Stop before this observation time, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00+02:00. This is a data boundary, not the job date; rolling runs calculate it

branch_8_filter_unavailable_results.description: Branch 8 | Do answers become known later? true = exclude rows whose answer was not yet available at the chosen time; false = use supplied answers

branch_8_result_availability_lag_hours.description: Branch 8 | When result_cutoff is blank, subtract this many hours from run start. Enter 0 to 87600; example: 48 excludes results available in the last two days. An explicit result_cutoff overrides this lag for every run

branch_8_result_available_at_column.description: Branch 8 | Column recording when each answer became known, e.g. claim_confirmed_at. This is a column name, not a date you enter

branch_8_result_time_kind.description: Branch 8 | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_8_result_text_kind.description: Branch 8 | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_8_result_time_format.description: Branch 8 | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_8_result_time_timezone.description: Branch 8 | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_8_result_date_only.description: Branch 8 | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_8_result_cutoff.description: Branch 8 | Use answers known by this time, INCLUDING this instant, e.g. 2026-09-15T00:00:00+02:00. An explicit cutoff applies to every run; blank derives run start minus result_availability_lag_hours

branch_8_max_rows.description: Branch 8 | Maximum rows transferred into Python memory per read; exceeding this stops the run. This does not randomly sample rows

branch_8_max_input_mb.description: Branch 8 | Maximum input data size transferred into Python memory, in MiB (64 = 64 MiB). Model training can use more RAM

branch_8_training_sample_rows.description: Branch 8 | Optional sample: enter 10000 to select up to 10000 eligible rows BEFORE train/test splitting. null = no sampling. Prediction rows are never sampled

branch_8_training_sample_seed.description: Branch 8 | Seed for choosing the same sample from the same table snapshot. Keep 42 unless you want another sample

branch_8_regression_model.description: Branch 8 | Choose a regression model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_8_regression_model_weighted.description: Branch 8 | Choose a regression model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_8_classification_model.description: Branch 8 | Choose a classification model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_8_classification_model_weighted.description: Branch 8 | Choose a classification model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_8_model_params.description: Branch 8 | Optional JSON object of fixed model parameters. For voting/stacking, include base_estimators and any base_estimator_params or final_estimator to define the ensemble. Other models can set this in an init file or generated config

branch_8_search_strategy.description: Branch 8 | Choose grid, random, halving_grid, halving_random, or optional Optuna. Core supplies a model-appropriate default search space; grid strategies evaluate its full Cartesian product

branch_8_search_settings.description: Branch 8 | Use Core defaults for this strategy, or customize its controls below

branch_8_search_max_candidates.description: Branch 8 | Maximum full-grid combinations to admit (1-10000). Grid and halving_grid run every combination, so preflight rejects a larger space

branch_8_search_space.description: Optional init-file search override; otherwise Bundle writes Core-derived editable lists into this branch. Edit its generated search_space or clear it to {} for automatic resolution.

branch_8_regression_search_metric.description: Branch 8 | Objective for choosing regression parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_8_classification_search_metric.description: Branch 8 | Objective for choosing classification parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_8_search_n_trials.description: Branch 8 | Trials or initial sampled candidates for random, halving_random and Optuna (1-1000)

branch_8_search_timeout.description: Branch 8 | Optional Optuna soft stop in positive seconds; null disables it. A running estimator fit is not interrupted

branch_8_search_random_state.description: Branch 8 | Seed for sampled parameter choices, separate from the heldout split seed and CV fold seed

branch_8_search_factor.description: Branch 8 | Successive halving keeps roughly one in this many candidates per round (integer 2 or more)

branch_8_search_resource.description: Branch 8 | Halving budget resource: training rows or estimator n_estimators. n_estimators requires explicit max_resources and a compatible model

branch_8_search_min_resources.description: Branch 8 | Halving starting budget: exhaust, smallest, or a positive integer

branch_8_search_estimator_min_resources.description: Branch 8 | Starting estimator budget for n_estimators halving (integer 2 or more; must not exceed max_resources)

branch_8_search_max_resources.description: Branch 8 | Maximum estimator resource count for n_estimators halving; enter a positive integer compatible with the selected model

branch_8_search_sampler.description: Branch 8 | Optuna sampler: TPE, random or CMA-ES; CMA-ES samples categorical axes randomly

branch_8_search_pruner.description: Branch 8 | Optuna trial pruner; Core checks whether the selected model and validation method support early stopping. none disables pruning

branch_8_search_pruning.description: Branch 8 | Allow Optuna pruning when model and validation settings support it

branch_8_search_tune_threshold.description: Branch 8 | Select a binary decision threshold from inner out-of-fold predictions. Requires probability output; final holdout stays untouched.

branch_8_regression_metric.description: Branch 8 | Metric for comparing regression models on separate test data (heldout). Lower error is better; higher R2 or explained variance is better

branch_8_classification_metric.description: Branch 8 | Metric for comparing classification models on separate test data (heldout). Some metrics need probabilities or specific class counts

branch_8_min_improvement.description: Branch 8 | Minimum metric improvement required for manual or automatic promotion; ties never pass

branch_8_quality_threshold.description: Branch 8 | Absolute quality gate; numeric required for automatic promotion or manual first-champion approval. Choose for your metric and task.

branch_8_quality_gates.description: Branch 8 | Optional init-file JSON object of additional heldout metric thresholds, or null
